blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ: وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ لَوْ أَصْبَحَ فِيكُمْ مُوسَي ثُمَّ اتَّبَعْتُمُوهُ وَتَرَكْتُمُونِي لَضَلَلْتُمْ إِنَّكُمْ حَظِّي مِنَ اْلاَُمَمِ وَأَنَا حَظُّكُمْ مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Thabit (RA) narrates, “Hazrat Umar (RA) came to the presence of the Prophet ﷺ and said, “O Rasulullah! I met a brother of mine from the tribe of Banu Quraizah on the way. He (thinking of my good) wrote down for me some comprehensive passages, rich in meaning, from the Torah. If you permit, I will present them before you!’ Hazrat Abdullah ibn Thabit (RA) says, (on hearing this) the colour of the Prophet ﷺ's face changed. I said to Hazrat Umar (RA), “O Umar, do you not see the sign of anger showing on the blessed face of the Prophet ﷺ?” Hazrat Umar (RA) immediately (realised his mistake and) said, “We have accepted and are pleased with Allah as Rabb, Islam as deen and Muhammad ﷺ as Messenger.’ On hearing these words, the signs of anger left the blessed face of the Prophet ﷺ. Then Rasulullah ﷺ said, “By Him in whose hand is the soul of Muhammad! If Hazrat Musa (AS) were among you (now), and you followed him and left me (not following me), you would surely go astray! You have come as my share among the Ummahs. I have come as your share among the Prophets” (so your success lies only in following me).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: كُلُّ أُمَّتِي يَدْخُلُونَ
